incomeAssessment.scope: Targeted private modification/care payments, benefits and independent-living household resources; original clinical reference remains partial.
incomeAssessment.rationale: Current financing and access pathways are concrete, but no actual retained household award, excess payment, displaced private purchase or unique financial cohort is supplied. Provider package costs and institutional fiscal savings are not disposable client resources.
directions: Home access can replace actual private purchases or require excess financing; no client charge within public limits does not prove zero net resources.
Transitions may change benefits, rent, food, personal assistance and caregiver time jointly relative to institutional alternatives.
Documentation, travel and opportunity costs apply to all participating households regardless of clinical response; positive overlap discounts apply only to gains.
Employment and benefits access remain possible, unquantified pathways; no gross wages, retail care or ordinary survivor earnings are credited.
